name: cnsplots-v2
summary: Create, revise, and troubleshoot publication-ready scientific plots in Python with cnsplots (distribution, regression, heatmap, genomics, survival, set, flow, multi-panel). Supports exact physical dimensions (pt/mm/in), automated statistical annotations, editable SVG/PDF output, and dual execution modes (cnsplots native or zero-dependency pure matplotlib/seaborn via standalone cns_cell.mplstyle), with ~100 px/pt panel calibration, defaulting to Cell palette and Arial typography.

changes: Exported standalone styles/cns_cell.mplstyle for zero-dependency fallback via pure matplotlib/seaborn.
Added proactive environment branching: prompt user to choose between installing cnsplots or using pure mplstyle.
Enforced ~100 px/pt (80, 100, 120, 150) panel sizing baseline and strict prohibition of font/marker manual overrides.
Set Cell Press 10-color palette as the default qualitative palette, with support for Nature, Science, and other journal styles.
Set Arial sans-serif typography as the default font hierarchy across templates and workflows.
Streamlined architecture into clean styles, scripts, templates, and focused references, removing redundant files.
